acceptance: A release UAT shard whose cells all pass reports package exit code 0.
The salt value never appears in logs or uploaded artifacts.
No other workflow that packages UAT results is left without the salt.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage1-duckdb: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells. The refusal text is in the 'Run the stage 1 shard' step log of job 'UAT stage 1 duckdb'.

2026-11-01: #3878 (cd374960b6) made `benchbox submit` create a salt automatically at ~/.benchbox/submission_salt when neither BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT nor the file exists, so the package phase should no longer refuse. Not yet verified on a release-v2 run. Note: each shard has a fresh HOME, so each shard would generate its own salt (pseudonyms differ per shard). If release UAT packaging needs stable pseudonyms, set the repository secret as BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT; otherwise confirm the next run's package phase exits 0 and close.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. The real hosted gate proceeded through all 710 selected cells; none of its eight failures was a package-salt failure. This is evidence for the current package/run path, not a claim about every historical shard configuration. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

Closed 2026-11-11 against current evidence: PR #3878 (cd374960b6) creates the pseudonym salt automatically; UAT packaging runs `benchbox publish run`, which uses it. Trunk UAT 42718296767 (52615914) and scheduled 42789483182 (ce39d768): every shard package exit 0; salt value never logged (only its path). Test: test_release_gate_packaging_never_needs_a_public_pseudonym_salt. Per-shard salts differ (fresh HOME); set the BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT secret if stable pseudonyms are ever needed.
description: In release-v2 the UAT package phase exits 1 on every shard, even when every cell passes (DuckDB 57/57, DataFusion and ClickHouse Local 89/89). Each `benchbox submit` call refuses: 'Community publish requires a non-empty public pseudonym salt. Set the BENCHBOX_MACHINE_ID_SALT environment variable' (benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py:205). The shard environment (.github/actions/release-uat-env, .github/workflows/release-v2.yml) never sets the salt. Decide whether release UAT packaging should use a deployment-private salt from a repository secret (owner creates the secret) or a packaging mode that does not need one, then wire it.
